9550.overview: No-one likes a bad loser. And no-one comes more universally despised than the Xenites. For a thousand years they have been plotting revenge for their humiliating defeat in the last Galactic Conflict. Now the very fabric of time is in danger... The Xenites have planted five Time Bombs through history. Only you can save the day - not to mention the Universe. The last time you met it was a playground scrap. This time it's war.

20689.overview:
Viewed from above, the task in each level of X-It is to create a path to walk through to the exit, by moving blocks around a walled arena. The movement physics are fairly true to real life - most blocks can only be pushed if there is a block's worth of space behind them, and nothing immediately ahead of them. 

The levels are full of gaps, through which blocks can be pushed - this has the double effect of freeing up extra room in the level, and allowing you to walk over those spaces. Other hazards include ice which prevents blocks from stopping until they go past it. Falling through holes loses you one of your 3 lives - you also have 5 attempts at each screen.

20690.overview: It is 2019. Something unbelievable has happend, for which 12 billion people have waited for a long time. The first contat with extraterrestrial life! But the aliens were not friendly and conquered the earth bit by bit. The special thing was that they did not come from space, but from the seas. They are aliens, that live in the water and came here by an artifically created Einstein-Rosen Bridge. Through this wormhole came not only the aliens, but also strange alien sea animals and they now render the coasts uncertain. Unfortunately, the world government found no experienced submarine pilot, to pit himself against the water aliens. Only a retired submarine veteran with an alcohol problem could be persuaded for this mission...

93565.overview:
In this game the player assumes the role of a space pilot named Darrian. One day, he receives a report from a nebula space station, from which he learns that nearby human colonies have been attacked by mysterious aliens known as Xenites. Darrian wastes no time, and sets off to protect the humans and stop the aliens.

Xenon is an overhead shooter, in which the player controls a vehicle that is able to transform into a tank or a plane. The transformation can be usually performed by player at any time, to combat particular enemies; however, during some sequences the player is forced to use a specific type of vehicle. During the tank gameplay, the player controls the movement of the playfield (up or down) by simply moving the tank in the direction of choice.

122059.overview:
You have landed your crippled ship at the Atargis mining station. The platform was deserted and no one answered your radio calls. Now you are forced to enter the station and find a way to get off the asteroid. Hopefully whatever happened to the 200 personnel in the labyrinth of mines under the station won't happen to you too.

Xenomorph is a first person RPG. Like in the Dungeon Master series, everything happens in real time. You move around in 10 footsteps and can turn 90 degrees. You have two hands to fight and use items with, a belt and holster for quick access to weapons, as well as an inventory for carrying things.

The objective of the game is to find parts to repair your ship. You must also find food and water for sustenance and guns, grenades and mines for self defense. Other items can help you during your mission such as environmental suits, security passes and a motion detector. Data disks found throughout the station will fill in the story.

126229.overview:
XP8 is a vertically scrolling shoot-'em-up featuring raytraced graphics with many reflections.

Eight different weapons are on offer, which can be powered up to several stages, and are collected from tokens, sometimes in hidden sections. A simultaneous two-player mode is offered, which makes getting through the five levels (with passwords for each one) a little easier. The introduction takes the form of a few static screens.

135954.overview:
Xenos. The very name strikes fear into every colonist's heart. A distress call is received from space stations orbiting your homeworld, then silence. A single ship escapes, piloted by a battered man who tells the tale of pods that hatch into acid-spitting Xenos. A small band of engineers has been dispatched to combat the Xeno threat before it takes over all the space stations and, eventually, your homeworld.

Xenophobe is a side-scrolling shooter with platform elements. Assemble your band of engineers and fight the Xenos on each station, striving to either clear it or abandon it. You start out with a standard issue laser, but can pick up additional weapons as you find them, including Phasers, Lightning Rifles, Poofer guns, and bombs.

146333.overview:
Xybots is a sci-fi shooter with pseudo-3D environments explored from a third-person perspective. The game can be played by one or two players; the two-player mode takes place on a split screen. The hero(es) must move through a series of Gauntlet-style underground mazes, killing the bad guys and collecting health and other bonuses from flying saucers. It's designed to be played co-operatively, although bullets from one player can harm the other.

The Xybots are out to stop the protagonists, and many have advanced attack patterns as well as bullets to fire at them. Being able to view round corners is useful, allowing the player to plan a strategy - often it's good to send one player forward and let the other play the waiting game, similarly to the tactics often employed in Gauntlet.

151366.overview: XR-35 Fighter Mission is a horizontally scrolling shooter, developed and published by Anco Software, which was released in Europe in 1988.

151367.overview:
As usual, a computer has been put in control of vast stretches of an intergalactic empire. As usual, it has failed and locked the entire area into limbo. As usual, you're the one who has to sort this mess out, by reaching the computer and destroying it.

Unfortunately, the area en route to it is vast and treacherous, with lots of obstacles to shoot out, and you will need to trade your items in order to get enough fuel to get there.

The gameplay resembles Elite, involving first-person space shooting and trading.

151370.overview: Xenex is an action game, developed and published by Scorpius, which was released in Europe in 1994.

152623.overview:
XTreme Racing is a racing game that utilizes real 3D environments, as opposed to the sprite-based Lotus and the unshaded polygons of World Circuit. The game features a wide environment with full freedom of movement and some Mode 7-style effects. Various pre-made characters can be chosen to represent the player. A course designer and a sound editor are included as well. 

The difficulty level is customizable, and the cars don't "cheat" in terms of artificially keeping up with the player-controlled vehicle or pushing it out of the way and continuing at unabated speed. There many weapons on track to be picked up and fired at will, to deal with the opponents in a more unorthodox way.

Multiplayer options allow up to eight human players to compete, achieved linking two systems, similarly to Super Skidmarks.

178295.overview: Xorron 2001 is an 2D platform game, developed by Digital Dreams and published by Starbyte, which was released in 1989.

203097.overview: Unusual 'Jewel' type of game—drag two or three in a row to take them off the board. Problem is taking them off the board leaves a ‘hole’, putting you in a ‘corner’ so you can’t move other pieces. X-Swap Booming Edition is a Puzzle game, developed and published by Black Fantasy, which was released in Europe in 1997.

203098.overview: X-ploit is 2D side-scrolling action game with action set in future - mankind successfully defended against alien emperor, but people were turned into strange creatures. The player controls a green ball with feet, eyes and nose, named Spunky, who wants to destroy alien emperor. The game has simple rules - Spunky goes straightforward, jumps over holes and other obstacles, and collect various bonuses. He can shoot to destroy enemies and obstacles - but he has limited ammo. Spunky has small helicopter to fly, but fuel is also limited. Like in first Super Mario Bros. he can't go back (left).

211789.overview: In this sequel to Xenomorph written by Aidan Boustred of Culture you must defeat the aliens. While the original was considered an RPG, this top down view game has a realtime wargame feel to it. It has 4 levels and supports one or two players and cooperative play. In this one you control the space marines who must secure the base from the alien threat.

211826.overview: Precursor to Crossfire II, this shooter was created by Thomas Schulze, Dirk Böhme and Stefan Schulze was originally released but later changed to mailware as the author believed nobody was interested in it, the full version was eventually released to aminet.

212052.overview: A horizontal shoot-em-up made in Backbone by Lemming880 of the Netherlands in 2015. Shoot your way through a hazard filled maze and make it to the exit!

212053.overview: Made for Christmas Tree Competition 2009, the game was put together in two weeks. Nice graphics and music. Santa's army has decided that this was the last Christmas the brats have their way and tries to take over the world by plunging it into deep winter and taking it over when everyone is huddled near the fireplace. Take down all the Christmas creatures and fight the boss, you must shoot each armor piece to remove it.

212123.overview: Xpedition is a side-scrolling science fiction action shooter. The game allows you to assemble a team of four members, including marines and mechs, assign equipment and select one of a few available extended missions. The player can control only one team member at a time. Aside of killing every hostile creature the game requires you to complete small side quests, such as repairing a broken mechanism or capture an alien.

212163.overview: Xenostar is a multi-directional shoot 'em up modeled after the Sinistar (1982). While you guide your modest but frantic spacecraft around and try to mine minerals, red constructor ships are also busy mining them, protected by grey defense ships. With the minerals, they will try to construct Xenostar, an incredibly evil and hungry entity. Converting the minerals you collect into Xenobombs, you stand a chance of destroying this monster once he announces... "I live!''

212236.overview:
Since man was first able to reason he has pondered the question of, "what is the meaning of life?... Until now the answer has always been elusive. Using your skill and dexterity, find your way through the 50 levels and exit and all will be revealed. The base launcher is controlled by the mouse. Ammo is fired by the base launcher. Atom is fatal if touched by base. Arrow disks can be used to move your pod in the indicated directions. Ammo disks will add 5 shells to your ammo until it reaches 39 max. Time disk adds 20 seconds to limit. Guide the pod around the levels and collect keys. Shoot to move tiles in that direction. When all the keys have been collected the exit will be revealed. 

Game comes with level editor... in case you would like to edit that last level and take a look.

212516.overview: A multi-genre game featuring game sections of Avoid-it, Shooter Platforming areas. and Avoid the asteroids, your shuttle may feel bulky but it is nimble and a good pilot should be able to avoid the deadly bodies and transfer to the where you can fight the Borg Defense ship, blast it as quickly as possible and avoid damage. Then board the ship and find your way to the bridge level collecting disks.

212517.overview: An Italian language Space Invaders clone from A Raffaele, made using AMOS this freeware game is well made and has many features like a zeppelin in the place of the saucer of earlier versions and bonuses like moneybags that can be picked up.

212518.overview: Created in in Blitz BASIC by Marcus Oblak, in this game you build a circuit to steer both balls into the Proto-Box. You can use static or dynamic objects. If you fail you can remove them and try again. Dynamic objects can be removed in LIFO mode only, so last one in MUST be the first one out. Your only enemy is time.

212520.overview: Released as a game demo in 1993 on Amiga Format 54, this crosshairs shooter you guide the purple sphere-craft around the level, using the crosshairs to shoot multi-directionally. Avoid contact with the other creatures but rescue the fluffies and items and avoid mines. Alien Flux combines totally original gameplay, modern pseudo-3D graphics and unique sound effects to create a fast and furious shoot-em up style arcade game, the aim of which is to rescue Fluffies (the cutest creatures in the universe), from invading forces from the fifth dimension.

212648.overview:
It is a time of Chaos. It is a time of despair. It is X-MasTime!
 
Featuring: Santa Claus as himself
 
Game released at The Party 3 in Herning, 1993. 7 levels of Christmas platform fun. Then it repeats with more difficulty. Smash the bad toys with your bag and pick up the pressies. Grab clocks to get more time

212657.overview: A one or two player, Christmas themed, Tetris clone by Jani Parviainen of Overdose, because when you think of Christmas you should think of Overdose. Clearing lines reveals a seasonal picture, but you will need to be good to see the whole thing.

214683.overview:
Syman is a simple and fun memory game for all the family, playable by up to four people simultaneously. Syman is based on the original MB 'Simon' game, with inspiration drawn from the American Dad tv series, and is produced by a small team here at Ultimate Amiga. Simply watch the coloured tones played by Syman, and play them back.

The game was started from scratch on 12/12/09 with the goal of being finished in time for the Underground Arcade Christmas Competition which closed on Christmas Eve 2009.

214772.overview: A freeware Worm\Snake game by Tony Cheetham, released in 1991. This action game featured 5 speeds of difficulty. To win you had to cause your enemy to crash or touch a warp gate (shown as a sphere on the playing field).

214845.overview: An adult strip poker game. The author of this game planned to release it as commercial game, but no publisher could be found. Therefore this well-coded piece of software is now freeware. I think I need not say anything about game content ...

215070.overview: Mod for Gloom for both Amiga and AmigaCD32. Both 2 player co-op mode and 2 player combat mode are also available.  In each level, your objective is to find an exit before your 3 lives run out. In specific levels, you must defeat (or escape) enemy bosses.

217075.overview: The first Christmas version of Lemmings for the Amiga. Contains two unique levels from "Oh no, More Lemmings" and two new Christmas levels. An Oh No! More Lemmings Christmas themed demo. Special Christmas music by Andy Whyte. Released as a cover disk.

217076.overview:
The 1992 edition of Xmas Lemmings is another free demo intended to promote Lemmings and Oh No! More Lemmings. It includes four entirely new Christmas-themed levels, in the same style as the 1991 demo: Jingle Bells and other Christmas songs as background music and the Lemmings moving through snowscapes dressed in Santa outfits. The holiday levels from the earlier demo were comparatively easy, but this one also includes some brain teasers comparable to levels from the main games' higher difficulties. 
 
Lemmings and Oh No! More Lemmings Christmas themed demo. Contains four unique levels designed by Mark Tsai. Special Christmas music by Andy Whyte and Tobias (Toby) van de Peer.

286870.overview:
This is a transcode from the original arcade game (multiple Z80s) to 68K assembly.

FEATURES:

- game play is identical to the original arcade game, including the pseudo-random number generation

- original dipswitch options supported (except cocktail cabinet mode)

- all original graphics and colours reproduced perfectly on Neo Geo target

- 1 or 2 players supported

- high score load/save

CREDITS:

- Mark McDougall (aka tcdev): reverse-engineering, core and Neo Geo code and assets

- Jean-Francois Fabre (aka jotd): Amiga code and assets

- Andrzej Dobrowolski (aka no9): Amiga music

- Namco: original game :)

418302.overview: A virtually scrolling space shooter created with SEUCK, developed by Harry Hart, and is an UNOFFICIAL fan sequel to Xenon II.

419292.overview:
Atoms-X is a remake of an old game called Atoms I (  Rob Cranley aka Rob the Nerd ) had on the Amiga years ago. It was written by a reader of one of the Amiga magazines of the time and they gave it away on their cover disk. Something reminded me of it recently, and I had a quick search for it. It turns out there are a couple of basic clones for Linux and Android, and one or two for Amiga, but none that particularly appealed to me. So I decided to write my own version which is fully Workbench-friendly, and to include a computer opponent, something the original never had.

This version of Atoms-X includes 3 levels of difficulty for the computer players, although often the games get to a stage where even a totally random move can cause a massive chain reaction that wins the game, so don't get angry when the easiest computer opponent beats you!! The hardest level can really be a nasty opponent, making surprisingly tactical moves. Again though, sometimes it just comes down to luck...

420981.overview: Demo fighting game for one or two players, created by Kwok Man and due to be published by Thalion but unreleased. Punch, kick and do combos to beat your opponent.

422332.overview: A challenging homebrew space shoot-em-up game made with SEUCK by Gemsoft Interactive in 1995.

423168.overview: A single player crosshairs shooter made by Furio Catalano and published as a Coverdisk in Amiga Live. In the twenty first century only a real man or woman can save the earth... YOU!

449649.overview: A game by Andreas Uhl under the name Silicon Generation and published initially in 1989 and then later in the Amiga Supergame issue #4, published by Logo Software in 1990 along with Colwyns Abenteuer,  Raumstation, and Super Gridder.

450105.overview: A 1993 freeware puzzle game by Andrew Campbell of Black Dragon Design, created with AMOS and alternately known as X-Tiles 2.  "Simple, well-realised, and addictive!" - Amiga Computing (August 1993)

459019.overview:
XENOMORPH is heavily inspired by ALIEN BREED, although a darker, more tense setting was sought.
The goal was to slow down the gameplay by being more careful when confronting the Aliens.

468961.overview: Original Game by Mark Wirt, released by Commodore Business Machines (UK) Ltd. in 1984 for Commodore 16 and Plus/4.

481304.overview: The disk is damaged. Can you recover it? X-Sector is a new puzzle game for the Amiga.

481589.overview: It's a Space Invaders clone, The game is completely free, I used AI, this is version 1.0, I could improve it furthermore in the future.

482822.overview: XAHBall is HaxBall-style football for the classic Amiga: one screen, a round-cornered pitch, discs for players, a ball that pings off the posts, and up to six people crowded around one A500.
